curb_survival_analysis.dataset: SemanticKITTI Sequence 08 (real road class 40 vs sidewalk class 48)

honest_conclusion: Foveation preserves near-field elevation fidelity exceptionally: Ring 0 elevation RMSE is 0.0019 m with 99.88% hazard recall and 0.00 m boundary displacement. In the mid/far-field, coarsening increases elevation RMSE to 0.3835 m (Ring 2) and 0.6007 m (Ring 3), yet hazard recall remains >= 98.76% across all bands. Real curb elevation step survival: Ring 0 (PASS, 0.0644m), Ring 1 (FAIL, 0.0349m), Ring 2 (PASS, 0.1374m), Ring 3 (FAIL, 0.0m). Memory comparisons show a 935.7x capacity ratio vs 3D, and a measured occupied-cell ratio of 1.41x.
